name: claude-chat-reader
description: Speak Claude Code's latest reply aloud on demand (prose only — skips code, paths, and tool calls). Natural neural voice via Piper, falling back to spd-say. Nothing is spoken automatically.

commands.title: Claude Chat: Follow — Read New Replies Aloud
Claude Chat: Read Latest Reply Aloud (once)
Claude Chat: Read Reply From Session…

claudeChatReader.engine.description: Which TTS engine to use. 'auto' = Piper (natural neural voice) if its binary + model are present, else spd-say.

claudeChatReader.piperModel.description: Path to a Piper voice model (.onnx). Its .onnx.json sidecar must sit alongside it. Download more with: python3 -m piper.download_voices <name>.

claudeChatReader.rate.description: Speech rate for the spd-say fallback (-100 slowest … 100 fastest). Does not affect Piper.

claudeChatReader.voice.description: spd-say fallback voice type (e.g. male1, female1). Empty = speech-dispatcher default. Does not affect Piper.
